faqs.question: Why avoid page builders like Elementor or Divi?
faqs.answer: Page builders inject massive amounts of nested code, unused scripts, and redundant stylesheets that destroy mobile performance and Google Core Web Vitals scores. Our custom Gutenberg blocks provide identical visual flexibility with a fraction of the code weight.

faqs.question: Can you fix or speed up an existing slow WordPress site?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer forensic WordPress audits and refactoring services, stripping out bloated plugins, streamlining database queries, and implementing advanced caching to restore rapid load times.

faqs.question: Is WordPress secure for commercial business websites?
faqs.answer: Yes, when built correctly. WordPress vulnerabilities almost always stem from poorly coded third-party plugins and weak passwords. By building custom themes with minimal plugins and establishing enterprise security hardening, WordPress is exceptionally resilient.

faqs.question: Can you migrate our content from an older website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We execute automated and manual database migrations to carry across existing blog posts, news archives, customer records, and media libraries while preserving URL paths and SEO juice.
